notes: firstRelease is the earliest published tag containing evidenceCommit, checked with `git tag --contains`. Compare kinds: eq = frozen value, gte = monotonic integer, members = string list membership, object = fixed-shape object.

capabilities.name: session_queue
capabilities.missing: Do not take over backend queues; existing queues keep their owner.

capabilities.name: computer_session_approval
capabilities.missing: Hide session-wide approval; confirm each computer action.

capabilities.name: memory_switch
capabilities.missing: Do not send the memory switch field; keep the saved value.

capabilities.name: image_model_toggle
capabilities.missing: Do not send model-level image toggles; keep legacy probing.

capabilities.name: session_exists
capabilities.missing: Use the existing migration check; never treat unknown as absent.

capabilities.name: session_changes
capabilities.missing: Disable incremental sync and fall back to full refresh.

capabilities.name: ai_review_per_run
capabilities.missing: Do not send review_scope; keep the global AI approval setting visible (it applies to every permission mode and auto review needs a configured reviewer model).

capabilities.name: permission_rules
capabilities.missing: Ignore permission.requested suggestion; offer only allow once (and the computer session grant), send allow_always without scope, hide the permission rules settings and ignore permission.auto_resolved.

capabilities.name: readonly_auto_allow
capabilities.missing: Expect read-only tools and commands to prompt in normal mode; set an explicit allow policy to skip those prompts.

capabilities.name: permission_modes
capabilities.missing: Block a send whose saved mode is unsupported; let the user pick per-call confirmation.

capabilities.name: image
capabilities.missing: Disable image UI; supported may change at runtime and bumps capabilityRevision.

capabilities.name: run_sandbox
capabilities.missing: Disable sandbox modes and never send options.sandbox; the backend would ignore it and run commands unconfined.

capabilities.name: subagent_transcripts
capabilities.missing: Keep subagents as plain tool rows: no live transcript, no /subagents endpoints and no stop button; subagent payloads lack parent_tool_call_id.

capabilities.name: sandbox_setup
capabilities.missing: Hide the sandbox setup action: run_sandbox has no setup_available or setup_hint and POST /v1/sandbox/setup does not exist; point Windows users at `kn sandbox setup` instead.

capabilities.name: question_selected_labels
capabilities.missing: Never send selected_labels (an older backend rejects the answer with 400 for the unknown field): answer a multi-select question with its labels joined by ", " in selected_label and custom: true, and expect no question_answers in history.

capabilities.name: mcp_elicitation
capabilities.missing: Never send options.mcp_elicitation (an older backend rejects the run with 400 for the unknown field) and show no elicitation forms: MCP servers cannot ask the user for input, and tool calls carry no elicitations in history.

capabilities.name: host_bridge
capabilities.missing: Do not register a host bridge (PUT /v1/host-bridge does not exist) and expect no host_bridge status in health: runs have no ReadTerminal for desktop terminals and no TunnelManager.

capabilities.name: ssh_manager
capabilities.missing: Do not send SSH hosts to /v1/settings/ssh (it does not exist) and expect no SSHManager tool in runs: keep SSH sessions on the desktop.

capabilities.name: skill_packs
capabilities.missing: Skills nested in skill packs are not found (only <root>/<name>/SKILL.md): /v1/skills items have no pack or shadowed and there is no shadowed list. Hide pack toggles and never send packs to PUT /v1/skills/settings (an older backend rejects it with 400 for the unknown field).

capabilities.name: background_tool
capabilities.missing: Offer no way to move a running command to the background (POST /v1/sessions/{id}/runs/{run_id}/tools/{tool_call_id}/background does not exist): a foreground Bash call runs until it ends, times out or the run is cancelled.

capabilities.name: session_archive
capabilities.missing: Never send archived on the session list, snapshots, changes or workdirs (an older backend ignores it and returns only unarchived sessions); archived sessions cannot be listed, so hide the archived view and its unarchive action, and treat a missing archived field on a summary as false.

capabilities.name: memory_organizer_settings
capabilities.missing: Hide the organizer schedule setting and never send memoryOrganizer in PUT /v1/settings (an older backend rejects the request with 400 for the unknown field); the organizer runs on the backend's -memory-organizer-interval (default 24h) and changing it needs a restart.

capabilities.name: session_external_runs
capabilities.missing: Session summaries never carry external_run and the session list notices sessions the kn terminal UI writes only on its 30-second full scan (or a rescan), after the turn ends; runs started by another process are not refused, so show no external-run indicator and expect no 409 for a session running elsewhere.
